description: AI-powered insurance agent training coach — auto-parses product docs, generates question banks, assesses agent skill levels (beginner/intermediate/advanced), schedules personalized daily training based on client visits, and delivers interactive role-play sessions. Updated for 2025-2026: covers predinig rate cut (3.0%) impact on sales scripts, new health insurance regulation, PIPL-compliant customer communication, and benchmark against AIA, Ping An, and Alibaba Cloud training systems.
